defs.en: A worded or expressed sentence, phrase, or only a word on its own, which asks for information, a reply, or a response; an interrogative.
A subject or topic for consideration or investigation.
defs.ex: The question of seniority will be discussed at the meeting.

defs.en: A doubt or challenge about the truth, accuracy, or validity of a matter.
defs.ex: His claim to the property has come under question.

defs.en: A proposal to a meeting as a topic for deliberation.
defs.ex: I move that the question be put to a vote.

defs.en: To ask questions of; to interrogate; to ask for information.
To raise doubts about; have doubts about.
To ask a question or questions; inquire or seek to know; examine.
With verbs, especially past participles.
With prepositional phrases and spatial adverbs.
With predicative adjectives.
With attributive adjectives, following an (especially indefinite) article; chiefly as expressing contrast, difference etc.
Preceding nouns introduced by the indefinite article. Chiefly in negative constructions.

ja: （反語的に）そこそこ、まあまあ。

defs.en: Indicates agreement; exactly so.
defs.ex: “That's a rather ugly colour for a house, don't you think?” — “Quite.”

ja: （強い同意）いかにも、そのとおり。

defs.en: A series of passes made with the cape to distract the bull.
A game in which players must only say questions, and if they don't they lose.
The kind, condition, and/or the set of characteristics of something, as opposed to the quantity of something.
defs.ex: The lattice structure of a steel profoundly changes its qualities.

defs.en: A single trait.
defs.ex: While being impulsive can be great for artists, it is not a desirable quality for engineers.

defs.en: Good characteristics in particular; level of excellence; freedom of faults and flaws.
defs.ex: This school is well-known for having teachers of high quality.

defs.en: Good worth, good make.
defs.ex: For this building project we need to use quality materials that will last for many decades.

defs.en: In a two-phase liquid–vapor mixture, the ratio of the mass of vapor present to the total mass of the mixture.
Rapidly; with speed; fast; with expedition.

defs.en: Very soon.
defs.ex: If we go this way, we'll get there quickly.

defs.en: Moving with speed, rapidity or swiftness, or capable of doing so; rapid; fast.
defs.ex: I ran to the station – but I wasn't quick enough.

defs.en: Occurring in a short time; happening or done rapidly.
Lively, fast-thinking, witty, intelligent.
defs.ex: You have to be very quick to be able to compete in ad-lib theatrics.

defs.en: Mentally agile, alert, perceptive.
defs.ex: My father is old but he still has a quick wit.

defs.en: Easily aroused to anger; quick-tempered.
defs.ex: She has a very quick temper.

defs.en: Quickly, in a quick manner.
Answer quickly.
Raw or sensitive flesh, especially that underneath finger and toe nails.
Plants used in making a quickset hedge.
The life; the mortal point; a vital part; a part susceptible to serious injury or keen feeling.
Quitchgrass.
A fast bowler.
